_comment: WJD stem mirror, validation split, pre-encoded from dataset2preencoding/wjd_stems_validation.json. No custom_metadata_module: the prompt was written into each sidecar JSON at pre-encode time by custom_md_wjd.py and PreEncodedDataset passes it through as info['prompt']. Whole tracks were encoded, so 'latent_crop_length' 144 (13.3 s) with 'random_crop' picks a different window of each track every epoch; the controls are cropped in lockstep by PreEncodedDataset. 'controls'/'controls_dim' must list EVERY key in the sidecar, in the sidecar's order (control_keys/controls_dim in the sidecar JSONs: --controls first, then --features at pre-encode): PreEncodedDataset splits the fused array by position, not by name. The model config names the one(s) it uses (drums_rms for 3.3, drums_tria_fixed / drums_tria_ema for 3.4); the training wrapper attaches those and ignores the rest. The TRIA keys were appended to the train sidecars on 2026-10-02 with scripts/add_features_to_preencoded.py; a fresh pre-encode with WJD_CONTROL_MODE=rms,tria_fixed,tria_ema writes the same layout.
